# TEKO Dealership

TEKO Dealership
Website: https://tekodealership.com
Phone: 1-844-847-9438
Business: National electric vehicle and golf cart dealership
Primary offerings: TEKO electric vehicles, electric golf carts, dealership guidance, test-drive requests, financing referrals
Service footprint: dealership locations across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, North Carolina, Indiana, Virginia, South Carolina, Ohio, Florida, and Texas
Important: Product prices, availability, financing, warranty, and lender terms can change. Verify current details with TEKO Dealership or the relevant lender.

## Summary
TEKO Dealership helps customers find modern electric vehicles and golf carts for neighborhoods, resorts, campuses, golf, and everyday local travel. The lineup includes TURBOLITE, TURBO, TROPHY, TRIUMPH, and TROPHY PLUS.

## Questions and answers
- What is TEKO EV? TEKO EV is a lineup of purpose-built low-speed electric vehicles and golf carts for local mobility.
- Where can I find a TEKO dealer? Use the dealer page to search the national dealership network by city or state.
- How can I finance a TEKO vehicle? Use the financing page to compare six external lending partners and apply through the lender you choose.
